events.description: Called when the name is pressed, to open or preview the file; left out, the name is plain text.
events.name: onOpen

events.description: Called by the download button; left out, there is none.
events.name: onDownload

events.description: Called by the retry button of a failed upload; left out, there is none.
events.name: onRetry

events.description: Called by the remove button; left out, there is none.
events.name: onRemove

props.description: The file name, shown as given (never translated); it also names the card's actions.
props.name: name

props.description: The size in bytes, written in the locale's digits and unit.
props.name: size

props.description: The MIME type, which picks the type mark; left out, the extension picks it.
props.name: type

props.description: An image of the file (an image's own URL, a PDF's first page), drawn in place of the type mark.
props.name: previewSrc

props.description: How far an upload is, 0 to 100; given, the card shows the upload's bar in place of the type and size.
props.name: progress

props.description:
Why the upload failed; given, the card shows it in the danger tone (an empty string says "Upload failed"), with a
retry button when `onRetry` is set.
props.name: error
